data.text: Hear my cry, God; attend to my prayer.
data.subtitulo: For the music director; with stringed accompaniment. Of David.

data.text: From the ends of the earth I call to you when my heart grows faint; lead me to a rock higher than I am.
For you have been my refuge, a strong tower against the enemy.
Let me dwell in your tent forever; let me take refuge in the shelter of your wings. Selah.
For you, God, have heard my vows; you have given me the inheritance of those who fear your name.
data.titulo: Thanksgiving and Prayer for the King

data.text: Add days to the days of the king; let his years extend through generation after generation.
Let him sit enthroned before God forever; appoint steadfast love and truth to guard him.
Then I will sing praise to your name forever, fulfilling my vows day after day.
